newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS sees Q4 1996 result unchanged from '95.
newsitem.headline: SAS sees Q4 1996 result unchanged from '95.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) expects 1996 fourth quarter pre-tax results to equal those of the same period last year, a company publication reported on Wednesday.
"We expect a fourth quarter comparable with that of last year, that is to say 487 million Swedish crowns," Inside SAS magazine quoted Finance Director Gunnar Reitan as saying.

The carrier last week published nine-month results showing pre-tax profit of 1.257 billion Swedish crowns, 40 percent lower than the same period last year. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +33 969653
